## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the smallest change that fixes it.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] Relevant tests
- [ ] `pnpm check:secrets`
- [ ] No populated `.env`, `.dev.vars`, or `wrangler.jsonc` files are included
- [ ] User-facing text is present in both English and Chinese
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when behavior changes

## Related issue

Link an issue when one exists.
